evidence: process_inbox_pr_review (products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:1130-1176, 1220-1229) parses the URL, resolves the team's enabled config by slug, fetches the PR, checks only state==open and a non-empty head sha, and stamps inbox_review provenance verbatim from its arguments; it never calls _is_bot_authored (tasks.py:124), never checks head.repo.full_name for forks (tasks.py:172-177 exists only in the webhook carve-out), never calls find_signal_implementation_run (tasks.py:190-199, webhook leg only), and never looks up task_run_id. The upstream receiver (products/review_hog/backend/receivers.py:95-140) takes output.pr_url at face value, and that key is caller-writable: TaskRunViewSet partial_update/set_output (products/tasks/backend/presentation/views/api.py:807-813, 1059-1118) accept free-form output JSON from Session/PersonalAPIKey/OAuth callers with task:write, _apply_caller_output protects only pr_merged (products/tasks/backend/facade/api.py:1770-1790, whose docstring even anticipates 'the caller points the run at a different pr_url'), and task_control_q lets any team member drive runs on origin_product=signal_report tasks (products/tasks/backend/visibility.py:22-45) or create their own (serializers.py:595-640 rejects only image_builder). Downstream, activities.py:448-451 sets self_driving_review=True from output['inbox_review'] under a comment claiming both trigger paths stamp it 'only after positively linking the PR', which is false for this leg; the engine then relaxes the bot-author refusal and draft prerequisite (tools/pr-approval-agent/review_local.py:321-326, review_pr.py:590) and injects a 'Provenance: ... verified by task linkage' TRUSTED block into the prompt (reviewer.py:683-702), while the server-side author-write-permission, author_association, fork, and review-mode gates are skipped by design (AGENTS.md:110-112, justified by an assumption of bot authorship that is never verified here). tasks.py:100-103 and 222-224 state those gates exist precisely so an under-privileged or fork author cannot obtain a branch-protection-satisfying approval, and test_integration.py:1385-1430 confirms this leg posts a real head-pinned APPROVE; no receiver-leg test (test_tasks.py:924-1051) exercises a human-authored, fork, or unlinked PR. The unanchored _PR_URL_RE (tasks.py:113) is not itself exploitable since the fetch uses repo_config.repository, but the core claim stands.
notes: I would downgrade if the tasks API rejected caller writes to output.pr_url (adding it to _WEBHOOK_ATTESTED_RUN_OUTPUT_KEYS) or if process_inbox_pr_review required bot authorship, a repo-native head, and a facade linkage match like the webhook carve-out does.
